Thanks, Asha & team — looking forward to the call tomorrow at 2:30pm PST. A few items I wanted to share ahead of the intake so we can focus the call on clarifications versus reading the artifacts together:

Pre-read / quick pointers from Redwood security:
- We reviewed the CAIQ snapshot and added inline comments to the "Notes" tab; will surface those during the call.
- Log retention: default retention for API request/response logs is 30 days; configurable up to 365 days for enterprise customers via Redwood Dedicated or Private deployments. We can discuss retention controls and export options on the call.
- KMS: Redwood supports AWS KMS customer-managed keys in Private deployments and KMS envelope encryption for hosted customers; we will provide KMS integration documentation and rotation cadence examples.
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide redacted access-log samples and the control mapping matrix after a data-sharing agreement is in place.

Pre-call asks (helps speed evidence delivery):
- Please confirm whether the pilot will include PHI. If yes, we’ll flag additional controls and a different evidence set.
- If you have a list of required retention periods (logs, audit trails), paste them here so we can prepare export samples.
